dossier.summary: Custom sheet-metal and structural fabricator with one plant.
dossier.why_now: Lost two large bids this quarter.

data.notes:
Redhill Fabrication (redhill.example). Custom sheet-metal and structural fabricator, one plant, about 90 people. Champion: Ruth Castellano, Operations Manager.
Calls: Oct 15 (Ruth Castellano, Gary Lindqvist, Pablo Ortiz, Jess Hart) and Oct 23 (Ruth Castellano, Jess Hart).
Quotes, Oct 15. Ruth Castellano, Operations Manager: "We lose bids on speed. By the time our quote lands the buyer has two others and a favorite." Gary Lindqvist, Lead Estimator: "Two of us price everything. A big drawing set eats a full day and the small jobs wait behind it."
Quote, Oct 23. Pablo Ortiz, Sales Manager: "I promise buyers a quote in two days and I find out Friday whether we made it."
Numbers from Gary's September quote log, shared Oct 21: 46 quote requests received, 10 answered within 2 working days; median 62 hours from request to quote sent; about 2.5 estimator hours per quote.
Pilot scope: the sheet-metal line, which gets about 60 percent of requests. Quotes are built from drawings and the ERP price list, read-only. Weekly 30-minute review with Ruth and Kit.
Out until year one: structural quotes, the ERP write-back, customer portal.
Wants: median request to quote at 24 hours or less; 70 percent of quotes out within 2 working days; estimator time per quote at 1.5 hours or less. Today 10 of 46 quotes go out within 2 working days (22 percent).
Stakeholders: Ruth Castellano (sponsor and pilot lead, 1 hour a week); Gary Lindqvist (estimating, 3 hours a week); Pablo Ortiz (sales, 30 minutes a week); Jess Hart, Controller (pricing rules sign-off and the readout, 2 hours in total).
Dates: proposal sent Oct 29, valid for 30 days. Scoping call Nov 3. Price list export Nov 6. Proposal version 2 on Nov 9. Decision on the pilot Nov 12. Kickoff Nov 16. Pilot Nov 16 to Dec 16. Weekly reviews Nov 23, Nov 30, Dec 7 and Dec 14. Readout Dec 17. Decision on year one Dec 18.
data.offer:
Pilot: 30 days on one production line, fixed fee $2,900. It covers the price-list and drawing intake setup, training, four weekly reviews and the readout. The pilot fee is credited in full against year one if the customer signs by Dec 31, 2026.
Year one: sheet-metal and structural quoting for one plant, up to 8 users, $24,000 a year, billed annually.
Prices in US dollars, before tax. Proposals are valid for 30 days.

data.pilot_lead: Nov 16 to Dec 16 on the sheet-metal line with Gary Lindqvist's estimating team. Three criteria, measured against September.

data.pass_rule: The pilot passes when all three criteria are met across the last two weeks, Dec 3 to Dec 16. If it does not pass, there is no year-one commitment and the pilot fee is the only cost.
